# Investigate
## When to use
Repository orientation or a question.
## Required context
The relevant entry point.
## Preconditions
No implementation is requested.
## Procedure
Follow one trace, inspect sources, distinguish observations from inferences.
Activate `context-discovery` for broad orientation.
## Tools
Read-only search and inspection.
## Rules
Do not fill unknowns with guesses.
## Verification
Cross-check important claims.
## Evidence
Source paths and limitations.
## Completion criteria
The question has a grounded answer.
## Failure modes
Missing source: report uncertainty.
## References
[Exploration scope](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. Always run it from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
